heading: Engineering products from idea to production.
paragraphs: I design and build production systems across frontend, backend, databases, integrations, and infrastructure — owning problems from initial requirements through deployment rather than a single layer of the stack.

My day-to-day work spans product requirements, frontend development, backend architecture, API design, database modeling, authentication, third-party and AI integrations, payments, and cloud deployment.
I care about the decisions that determine whether a system holds up in production: how it's architected, how it scales, how it's secured, and how it's operated once real users depend on it.
